output.title: Signature algorithm customization may affect certificate generation
output.content: This environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate API and has certificates.cert-manager.io CRDs installed, which means certificate generation is active. The v1.18.0 feature allows customizing signature algorithms, which could affect how certificates are signed. Inspect the v1.18.0 release notes for details on: whether this is opt-in or changes defaults; which certificate types or issuers are affected; what configuration (if any) is needed in Certificate resources or cert-manager values.
